\expertauditsection{Reactions from the audit of benchmark targets}
\label{app:target_audit_cases}

This appendix shows reactions from the record-level audit of benchmark targets (Appendix~\ref{app:target_audit}). Table~\ref{tab:target_audit_agreement} groups the 53 controls by how many of the three independent chemistry-annotator completions match the benchmark target under the equivalence metric. For each level with at least one match, we show the control with the lowest ID (Figures~\ref{fig:target_audit_control_17}--\ref{fig:target_audit_control_177}). Control IDs follow the order of the curation app, in which the controls were embedded at random, so this choice does not depend on the reaction. We show all three controls without a match (Figures~\ref{fig:target_audit_control_35}--\ref{fig:target_audit_control_92}). Each figure shows the USPTO input, the FlowER target and the first completion of each annotator, drawn at the same scale. Shading marks molecules that differ between the target and a completion.
